items.q: Which intermolecular force acts between water molecules?
items.qAf: Watter intermolekulêre krag werk tussen watermolekule?
items.explain: Water molecules have hydrogen bonds between an H atom and a lone pair on an O atom.
items.explainAf: Watermolekule het waterstofbindings tussen ’n H-atoom en ’n eensame paar op ’n O-atoom.

items.q: Which substance has only London (dispersion) forces between its molecules?
items.qAf: Watter stof het net Londonkragte tussen sy molekule?
items.explain: Nitrogen is a non-polar molecule, so only London forces act.
items.explainAf: Stikstof is ’n nie-polêre molekule, dus werk net Londonkragte.

items.explain: HCl has an uneven charge distribution (a dipole) because chlorine is more electronegative.
items.explainAf: HCl het ’n ongelyke ladingsverspreiding (’n dipool) omdat chloor meer elektronegatief is.

items.q: Why does water boil at a much higher temperature than methane?
items.qAf: Waarom kook water by ’n baie hoër temperatuur as metaan?
options: Water has stronger hydrogen bonds between its molecules
optionsAf: Water het sterker waterstofbindings tussen sy molekule
items.explain: More energy is needed to overcome the strong hydrogen bonds in water.
items.explainAf: Meer energie is nodig om die sterk waterstofbindings in water te oorkom.

items.q: A larger molecule usually has a higher boiling point because it has:
items.qAf: ’n Groter molekule het gewoonlik ’n hoër kookpunt omdat dit het:
items.explain: Larger molecules have more electrons and larger surfaces, so stronger London forces.
items.explainAf: Groter molekule het meer elektrone en groter oppervlaktes, dus sterker Londonkragte.

items.q: Which alkane has the highest boiling point?
items.qAf: Watter alkaan het die hoogste kookpunt?
items.explain: Butane is the largest molecule of the four, so it has the strongest London forces.
items.explainAf: Butaan is die grootste molekule van die vier, dus het dit die sterkste Londonkragte.

items.q: The forces of attraction between molecules.
The strong intermolecular force between molecules with H bonded to N, O or F.
items.qAf: Die sterk intermolekulêre krag tussen molekules met H gebind aan N, O of F.

items.q: The weak forces between non-polar molecules caused by temporary dipoles.
items.qAf: Die swak kragte tussen nie-polêre molekules wat deur tydelike dipole veroorsaak word.

items.q: The amount of heat energy needed to raise the temperature of 1 kg of a substance by 1 °C.
items.qAf: Die hoeveelheid hitte-energie wat nodig is om die temperatuur van 1 kg van ’n stof met 1 °C te verhoog.

items.text: Stronger intermolecular forces cause a [[]] boiling point and a [[]] vapour pressure.
items.textAf: Sterker intermolekulêre kragte veroorsaak ’n [[]] kookpunt en ’n [[]] dampdruk.

items.q: Ice floats on water because it is less dense than liquid water.
items.qAf: Ys dryf op water omdat dit minder dig as vloeibare water is.
items.explain: True. Hydrogen bonds hold water molecules in an open lattice in ice.
items.explainAf: Waar. Waterstofbindings hou watermolekules in ’n oop rooster in ys.

items.q: Intermolecular forces are stronger than the covalent bonds inside molecules.
items.qAf: Intermolekulêre kragte is sterker as die kovalente bindings binne molekules.
items.explain: False. Intermolecular forces are much weaker than intramolecular (covalent) bonds.
items.explainAf: Onwaar. Intermolekulêre kragte is baie swakker as intramolekulêre (kovalente) bindings.

items.q: Explain why water (H₂O) has a much higher boiling point than hydrogen sulfide (H₂S).
items.qAf: Verduidelik waarom water (H₂O) ’n baie hoër kookpunt as waterstofsulfied (H₂S) het.
points: Water molecules have hydrogen bonds between them (H bonded to the very electronegative O).
H₂S has only weaker dipole–dipole/London forces, so more energy is needed to separate water molecules.
pointsAf: Watermolekules het waterstofbindings tussen hulle (H gebind aan die baie elektronegatiewe O).
H₂S het net swakker dipool-dipool-/Londonkragte, dus is meer energie nodig om watermolekules te skei.
